info.name: University Management System API
info.description:
Full REST API collection matching the redesigned schema: no Section/SectionFaculty, ProgramSemester + SemesterCourse curriculum model, admission + semester fee invoicing, comprehensive user/faculty/student lifecycle management, and real payment gateway integration.

## Getting started
1. Set `baseUrl` to your running server, e.g. `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`.
2. Run **1.Auth > Login - Admin**, **Login - Faculty**, or **Login** with a seeded demo account — auto-saves `accessToken`/`refreshToken`/`userId`.
3. All other requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection automatically.
4. Create-type requests (Department, Program, Course, SemesterCourse, SemesterEnrollment, Exam, Result, Invoice, Payment, StudentProfile, Faculty) auto-capture the new record's `id` into the matching collection variable.
5. **Get Program's Semesters & Curriculum** auto-captures `programSemesterId` from the first semester returned, so you can go straight from creating a Program to adding courses to its Semester 1.

## Demo credentials (from the seed script)
All seeded accounts share the password `Passw0rd!123`.
- ADMIN: `admin@university.edu`
- FACULTY: `rahim.uddin@university.edu`, `fatema.khatun@university.edu`, `kamal.hossain@university.edu`, `nasrin.akter@university.edu`, `shahidul.islam@university.edu`
- STUDENT: `arif.rahman@student.university.edu`, `nusrat.jahan@student.university.edu`, `tanvir.ahmed@student.university.edu` (and 17 more)

## Notes
- Enrolling in a semester (`POST /semester-enrollments`) auto-enrolls the student in every course of that semester — there's no separate manual course-registration step, since curriculum is fixed, not elective.
- Payments are never marked successful by a client — only `/payments/webhook` (the real gateway callback) does.
